children: Sunrise Realty Trust has approved the designation of Howard Sudnow to join its Board as an independent director effective at the Merger Effective Time in Q4 2026.
Designation by Southern Realty Trust in connection with Merger Agreement

Age 59; 30+ years in capital markets; Partner at MYST Advisors; former MD of Institutional Sales at Seaport Global; prior roles at Sterne Agee, Think Equity Partners, MSCI Barra; MBA, Wharton; BA, Franklin & Marshall College.
Has not been appointed to any Board committee as of filing date
